selectionQuestion: Must the audience compare role families, responsibilities, evidence, and adjacent paths?
exclusionCondition: Exclude when one role can be explained without cross-role mapping.

selectionQuestion: Must the audience see how competencies depend on or support one another?
exclusionCondition: Exclude when competencies are only an unordered checklist.

selectionQuestion: Must the audience see evidence-building tasks and prerequisite order over phases?
exclusionCondition: Exclude when duration, order, and prerequisites are not supported.

selectionQuestion: Must the audience inspect handoffs, feedback loops, decisions, or gates?
exclusionCondition: Exclude when the process has no meaningful handoff or branch.

selectionQuestion: Must the audience understand portfolio navigation, case-study nesting, and evidence placement?
exclusionCondition: Exclude when a short ordered section list is equally clear.

selectionQuestion: Must the audience compare multiple provisional growth paths, evidence gaps, and review points?
exclusionCondition: Exclude when the source supports only one next action or would imply a guaranteed progression.
